 Vacancy LNVH Project Officer SAFIA 
 Vacancy | Project Officer SAFIA 
LNVH, based at NWO-I in Utrecht, is looking for a Project Officer for the online toolkit Safety in Academia (SAFIA). 
LNVH is committed to strengthening social safety within Dutch academia, together with academics, institutions, policymakers and other partners across the sector. This year, LNVH received funding from the Steering Group Social Safety in Higher Education and Science to complete our SAFIA project: an online toolkit that brings together scientific knowledge, practical guidance and support in one place. 
SAFIA brings together scientific information on misconduct and intimidation and offers legal advice, emotional support, and practical information to academics who have experienced, witnessed, or been accused of harassment. SAFIA also serves as a platform where policymakers and administrators can find and share information and good practices, and where reports are systematically collected to make underlying patterns and facilitating factors visible. 
SAFIA is largely built from a technical standpoint and is ready for the next phase. The project officer will be the driving force behind the completion and launch of SAFIA. Read more about the responsibilities and required qualifications of the project officer in the full vacancy text (English follows Dutch). 
This is a temporary position of 0.8 FTE per week for a period of 6 months . The deadline for applications is September 10, 2026 . Please forward this vacancy to anyone who might be a good fit and could be interested.
